# RESOURCE_OUTPUT

Readable from a declared output of another resource, once that resource exists.

<!-- Generated by nix/signature-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

Canonically `resourceOutput`. A floe providing this must declare it
as `provides.resourceOutput`; a hole that resolves it may be called
anything.

*No built-in floe provides it.* A lab's own cluster floes can — they sit
beside the `lab.nix` that places them and are not in `floes/` — so this
is not the same as nothing answering it.
